# packages needed
```{r}

# Load libraries
library(leaflet)
library(mapedit)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(tigris)
library(leaflet.extras)
library(rnaturalearthdata)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)

options("install.lock" = FALSE)

# Define target coordinate reference system (CRS)
# Replace with the EPSG code appropriate for your project
target_crs <- 32614
```

# code for drawing shapefiles
```{r}
# Display reference counties
options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)

tx_counties <- tigris::counties(
  state = "TX",
  cb = TRUE,
  class = "sf"
)

study_counties <- tx_counties[
  tx_counties$NAME %in% c(
    "County 1", "County 2", "County 3" #change to your desired counties
  ),
]

# Build map
m <- leaflet() %>%
  addProviderTiles("OpenStreetMap") %>%
  addPolygons(
    data = study_counties,
    color = "blue",
    weight = 2,
    fill = FALSE,
    label = ~NAME
  ) %>%
  setView(lng = -97.5, lat = 26.2, zoom = 9)

# Draw polygon(s)
drawn_polygons <- mapedit::editMap(m)

# Convert to sf
sf_polygons <- drawn_polygons$finished

# Check that the source CRS is defined
if (is.na(sf::st_crs(sf_polygons))) {
  stop("The drawn polygons have no defined CRS. Assign the correct source CRS before reprojecting.")
}

# Reproject to target CRS
sf_polygons <- sf::st_transform(
  sf_polygons,
  crs = target_crs
)

# Save shapefile
sf::st_write(
  sf_polygons,
  "PATH/TO/OUTPUT_FOLDER/OUTPUT_FILENAME.shp",
  delete_dsn = TRUE
)
```

# Merge into a layer keeping individual attributes
```{r}
# Folder containing input shapefiles
input_folder <- "PATH/TO/INPUT_FOLDER"

# Output shapefile path
output_file <- "PATH/TO/OUTPUT_FOLDER/OUTPUT_FILENAME.shp"

# Find input shapefiles
shapefiles <- list.files(
  input_folder,
  pattern = "\\.shp$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

stopifnot(length(shapefiles) > 0)

# Read, validate, reproject, and retain attributes
shp_list <- purrr::map(shapefiles, function(f) {

  shp <- sf::st_read(f, quiet = TRUE)
  shp <- sf::st_make_valid(shp)

  if (is.na(sf::st_crs(shp))) {
    stop(paste("Missing CRS:", f))
  }

  shp <- sf::st_transform(shp, crs = target_crs)

  shp <- dplyr::mutate(
    shp,
    Source = tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(f))
  )

  shp
})

# Combine into one layer
combined <- dplyr::bind_rows(shp_list)

# Export combined shapefile
sf::st_write(
  combined,
  output_file,
  delete_dsn = TRUE
)

```


# code for merging AND dissolving into one attribute
```{r}
# Folder containing input shapefiles
input_folder <- "PATH/TO/INPUT_FOLDER"

# Output shapefile path
output_file <- "PATH/TO/OUTPUT_FOLDER/OUTPUT_FILENAME.shp"

# Find input shapefiles
shp_files <- list.files(
  input_folder,
  pattern = "\\.shp$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

stopifnot(length(shp_files) > 0)

# Read, validate, reproject, and retain geometry only
sf_list <- purrr::map(shp_files, function(f) {

  x <- sf::st_read(f, quiet = TRUE)
  x <- sf::st_make_valid(x)

  if (is.na(sf::st_crs(x))) {
    stop(paste("Missing CRS:", f))
  }

  x <- sf::st_transform(x, crs = target_crs)
  x <- dplyr::select(x, geometry)

  x
})

# Combine polygons
all_polygons <- dplyr::bind_rows(sf_list)

# Dissolve boundaries
dissolved_geometry <- sf::st_union(all_polygons)

# Create output feature
dissolved_layer <- sf::st_sf(
  ID = 1,
  geometry = dissolved_geometry
)

# Export dissolved shapefile
sf::st_write(
  dissolved_layer,
  output_file,
  delete_dsn = TRUE
)
```
